scripts.test: node --test 'test/unit/**/*.test.js'; u=$?; node --import ./test/support/register.mjs --test 'test/e2e/**/*.test.js'; e=$?; exit $((u | e))
scripts.lint: find mod mock scripts test \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && sh -n scripts/install.sh
scripts.audit: test ! -e .nsprc.js && test ! -e .nsprc.cjs && cp config/audit-allowlist.json .nsprc && better-npm-audit audit --package-manager npm --production -l high --require-notes --require-expiry
